title: DL0410 Alleviates Memory Impairment in D-Galactose-Induced Aging Rats by Suppressing Neuroinflammation via the TLR4/MyD88/NF-kappaB Pathway.
authors: Zhang, Baoyue; Lian, Wenwen; Zhao, Jun; Wang, Zhe; Liu, Ailin; Du, Guanhua
one_liner_zh: 该文研究DL0410在衰老模型中的神经保护作用，涉及TLR4/NF-kB通路和分子对接，但核心是药物抗炎机制，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: Oxidative stress and neuroinflammation have been demonstrated to be linked with Alzheimer's disease (AD). In this study, we examined the protective effects of DL0410 in aging rats and explored the underlying mechanism against oxidative damage and neuroinflammation, which was then validated in LPS-stimulated BV2 microglia. We firstly investigated the improvement effects of DL0410 on learning and memory abilities and explored the potential mechanisms in D-gal-induced aging rats. An 8-week treatment with DL0410 significantly improved the learning and cognitive function of D-gal-stimulated Alzheimer's-like rats in the Morris water maze test, step-down test, and novel object recognition test, and the therapeutic effect of DL0410 at 10 mg/kg was even better than that of donepezil. What is more, the results showed that DL0410 alleviated neuron injury, increased the number of synapses, and improved the level of postsynaptic density protein 95 (PSD95) in the hippocampus and cortex. Next, we examined the protective effects of DL0410 against oxidative damage and neuroinflammation. Our observations indicated that DL0410 reduced the production of harmful oxidation products and promoted the antioxidative system, decreased the levels of proinflammatory cytokines, including tumor necrosis factor alpha (TNF-alpha), interleukin 1beta (IL-1beta), and interleukin 6 (IL-6), and increased anti-inflammatory cytokines IL-10. Moreover, DL0410 inhibited the activation of astrocytes and microglia and suppressed the activation of the TLR4/MyD88/NF-kappaB signaling pathway. The anti-inflammation effect of DL0410 was further confirmed in LPS-stimulated BV2 cells, and the results showed that DL0410 reduced the level of inflammatory factors and inhibited the activation of the TLR4/MyD88/TRAF6/NF-kappaB signaling pathway in BV2 microglia. Molecular docking results indicated that DL0410 occupied the LPS recognition site in the TLR4/MD2 complex. Furthermore, the enhanced expression of claudin-1, claudin-5, occludin, CX43, and ZO-1 indicated that DL0410 protected the blood-brain barrier (BBB) integrity. Together, these results suggest that DL0410 exerts neuroprotective effects against hippocampus and cortex injury induced by D-galactose, and the possible mechanisms include antioxidative stress, antineuroinflammation, improving synaptic plasticity, and maintaining BBB integrity, which is mediated by the TLR4/MyD88/NF-kappaB signaling pathway inhibition. We suggest that DL0410 is a promising candidate for AD treatment.
abstract_zh: 氧化应激和神经炎症已被证明与阿尔茨海默病（Alzheimer's disease, AD）相关。在本研究中，我们考察了DL0410对衰老大鼠的保护作用，并探讨了其对抗氧化损伤和神经炎症的潜在机制，随后在脂多糖（LPS）刺激的BV2小胶质细胞中进行了验证。我们首先研究了DL0410对学习和记忆能力的改善作用，并探讨了其在D-半乳糖诱导的衰老大鼠中的潜在机制。为期8周的DL0410治疗显著改善了D-半乳糖刺激的阿尔茨海默样大鼠在Morris水迷宫测试、步降测试和新物体识别测试中的学习和认知功能，且DL0410在10 mg/kg剂量下的治疗效果优于多奈哌齐。此外，结果表明DL0410减轻了神经元损伤，增加了突触数量，并提高了海马和皮层中突触后密度蛋白95（PSD95）的水平。接下来，我们检查了DL0410对抗氧化损伤和神经炎症的保护作用。我们的观察表明，DL0410减少了有害氧化产物的产生，促进了抗氧化系统，降低了促炎细胞因子（包括肿瘤坏死因子α（TNF-alpha）、白细胞介素1β（IL-1beta）和白细胞介素6（IL-6））的水平，并增加了抗炎细胞因子IL-10。此外，DL0410抑制了星形胶质细胞和小胶质细胞的激活，并抑制了TLR4/MyD88/NF-kappaB信号通路的激活。DL0410的抗炎作用在LPS刺激的BV2细胞中进一步得到证实，结果显示DL0410降低了炎症因子的水平，并抑制了BV2小胶质细胞中TLR4/MyD88/TRAF6/NF-kappaB信号通路的激活。分子对接结果表明，DL0410占据了TLR4/MD2复合物中的LPS识别位点。此外，claudin-1、claudin-5、occludin、CX43和ZO-1表达的增强表明DL0410保护了血脑屏障（BBB）的完整性。综合这些结果，DL0410对D-半乳糖诱导的海马和皮层损伤发挥神经保护作用，其可能机制包括抗氧化应激、抗神经炎症、改善突触可塑性和维持BBB完整性，这些作用由TLR4/MyD88/NF-kappaB信号通路抑制介导。我们建议DL0410是AD治疗的有前景候选药物。
